breakdown.title: The Heron Teacher
breakdown.logline: Late for an exam, a dreamer returns to their old school and finds a classroom of faceless students, then flies away beside their maths teacher transformed into a grey heron.

colours.value: bright saturated green, dull grey classroom

light.value: bright corridor, dull dim classroom, moonlit town

breakdown.world_logic: The dreamer accepts impossible things as normal: knowing they are late without knowing the subject, a teacher becoming a heron, flying effortlessly.

identity.value: the dreamer, former student at the school

appearance.value: smooth skin with no facial features

landmarks.value: lockers on both sides, wooden door with small round window at the end
blackboard at front, windows with a view of the town

moments.action: The dreamer walks quickly down a long green corridor with lockers on both sides, heading for a wooden door with a small round window at the end.
moments.looks_at: the wooden door at the end
moments.visual_point: the long green corridor with lockers and the door at the end

moments.action: The dreamer looks through the small round window in the door and sees students sitting in rows at desks, all facing forward.
moments.visual_point: the round window with students visible through it

spots.name: the wooden door with the small round window

moments.action: The dreamer opens the door and steps into the classroom. Mrs Okafor stands at the blackboard in a red cardigan, writing numbers and not turning around.
moments.visual_point: Mrs Okafor at the blackboard in her red cardigan, seen three-quarters from behind, looking toward the left of the picture, from the left third of the picture, filling the picture from a third of the way down to its middle

moments.action: The dreamer stands inside the classroom, looking at the students. Their faces are smooth skin with no features, and they are completely still.
moments.dream: The students have no faces, just smooth skin.

moments.action: The grey heron stands facing the blackboard, its back to the camera.
moments.visual_point: the grey heron wearing a red cardigan in front of the blackboard, seen from behind

leaves.now: transformed into a grey heron with red cardigan

moments.shift: Mrs Okafor becomes a tall grey heron while staying in her red cardigan
moments.dream: The teacher is now a bird.

moments.action: The heron walks to the window on her long legs and flies out, and the dreamer flies beside her.
moments.visual_point: the dreamer and the heron flying out the window together
moments.purpose: the dreamer and the heron flying out the window together
moments.dream: Flying without any effort or explanation.

moments.action: The dreamer drifts alongside the heron over the town, looking down at the school roof and the shining river.
moments.looks_at: the town below with the school roof and river
moments.visual_point: the view of the school roof and river from the air

spots.name: the town below with the school roof and river

style_options.lighting_rules: Light seems to come from an unseen, uniform source, casting no sharp shadows. Edges are slightly blurred, as if the image is out of perfect focus. The overall light is dim but colours remain vivid, giving a sense of heightened but muted atmosphere.

style_options.name: a soft pencil drawing
style_options.dream: everything drawn with a stillness that holds its breath
style_options.line: monochrome graphite, like a memory sketched in a school notebook, smudged and uncertain
tokens: high contrast between light and dark
no sharp outlines, forms emerge from shading
style_options.lighting_rules: Shadows are soft and diffuse, blending into mid-tones. Edges dissolve into smudges, giving the entire scene a hazy, dreamlike quality.

style_options.name: a flat colour block print
style_options.dream: the whole scene flattened into layers like a theatre set, the unreality of it all
style_options.line: bold, flat shapes with limited palette, like a poster for a dream that never explains itself
tokens: solid blocks of colour with no gradients
style_options.lighting_rules: Lighting is implied by the flat shapes: shadows are absent, and depth is created solely by the separation of colour planes. Edges are sharp and clean, with no blending, enhancing the graphic, dreamlike absurdity.

style_options.name: just as it was
style_options.dream: light that comes from nowhere and casts no clear shadow, the stillness of a held breath, edges just slightly too soft
style_options.line: the dream exactly as it appeared, hyperreal yet quietly wrong
tokens: shallow depth of field in places
style_options.lighting_rules: Light appears natural but is too even, casting no clear shadows, as on an overcast day. The edges of objects are slightly softened, barely perceptible, and there is a pervasive stillness, as if time has paused. The overall atmosphere is quiet and unsettling.

The time of day and light conditions in the corridor and sky, as only brightness and dullness were mentioned.

m3.view: Seen from behind the dreamer, over their shoulder, about 2 metres off, at the height of their eyes: the camera looks at the blackboard, toward the right side of the room. A 14mm lens. From left to right across the picture: Mrs Okafor, the left third of the picture, seen three-quarters from behind, looking toward the left of the picture, seen whole and filling the picture from a third of the way down to its middle; then the faceless students, left of the middle of the picture, many of them, sitting in rows of seats in front of the dreamer, side on, looking toward the left of the picture; then the dreamer, the middle of the picture, in profile, looking toward the left of the picture, seen whole and filling the picture from near its top to two thirds of the way down. Nobody else is in the picture. They keep these places in every picture of this scene. Also in the picture: the blackboard, the left third of the picture, filling the picture from a third of the way down to its middle; the door, right of the middle of the picture, filling the picture from its top edge to near its bottom. At the left edge of the picture: the wall with the blackboard, the front of the place.

At the left edge of the picture: the wall with the blackboard, the front of the place.
